purpose: Teach: 翠/ギャング/ロータリー/ネイチャー/ジェーン/電撃/スパイラル/イングリッシュ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが翠色のネクタイを愛用された
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he was devoted to that jade-green necktie.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Slow, measured pace. Each memory offered like a small gift. Warm but tinged with the distance of decades. Let the voice linger on the image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ギャング映画の黄金期を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and you, when you were young, you loved watching those golden-age gangster films, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful counterpoint, a knowing smile in the voice. Teasing him gently for his own youth. Warm, slightly conspiratorial, like she's been waiting to remind him of something. The question tag carries affection, not doubt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがロータリークラブに入会された
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he joined the Rotary Club.
lines.style: Same wistful tone continuing. A little deeper now, speaking of substance and belonging. Quiet dignity in the memory. The voice settles on each detail like it matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、科学誌ネイチャーをご購読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — when you were young, you had that subscription to Nature magazine, didn't you?
lines.style: Light warmth with an edge of mild mockery. She's building her case — matching his memories with hers, point by point. Playful but not unkind. Slightly amused by his pretensions.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがジェーン・オースティンの英文学を研究された
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he devoted himself to studying Jane Austen's English literature.
lines.style: The wistfulness deepens. Speaking of intellectual ambition now, of a man shaped by serious things. The voice carries respect and a touch of melancholy — remembering not just the man, but what he wanted.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、電撃結婚されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — when you were young, you had that sudden marriage, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm laugh underneath. She's caught him now, gently. The delivery is light and knowing — this is the point she's been leading to. Affectionate teasing with a hint of 'I know you so well.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは事業のスパイラル成長を実現された
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he achieved remarkable spiral growth in his business.
lines.style: A shift toward solemnity and pride. Speaking of accomplishment and vision. The voice carries weight — this was no small thing. Respectful, almost formal in tone, honoring what was built.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、私にイングリッシュレッスンを勧められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — when you were young, you suggested I take English lessons, didn't you?
lines.style: The final strike, delivered with warmth and gentle victory. A closing note of tenderness. She's shown him how much she remembers, how much he shaped her. The voice softens at the end — this last memory is hers, not his.
